text:
maria: Heads up — during the quant bring-up (q8->q4 trial) we observed ~4% regression on the golden set vs fp16. Looks like many failures cluster around tokenization/deid truncation differences. Can we triage? :eyes:
cheng: Do we have the failure diffs? I pulled the bench run: https://benchboard.redwood/compare/3745 — looks like tokenized length shifts and mismatched end-of-sentence tokens in ~12% of fails.
olivia: I can run an audit. Plan: sample 500 failing examples, check tokenizer ids and deid markers, and surface patterns. Will need a small relabel batch if it's annotation noise.
dan: Agree we should freeze golden writes until we understand root cause. Also labelers need a provenance signal so we don't mix model-variant failures into the goldset.
sam: I can add provenance fields: model_variant, tokenizer_hash, quant_profile. Should be a minimal schema change.
maria: OK — immediate plan: add provenance, freeze golden updates, create audit queue 'quant-golden-audit', sample failset, relabel priority 1k, then decide rollback vs fix. Who owns sampling?
olivia: I'll own sampling + first audit. Will produce a csv with tokenized diffs and an example set. Target: first batch by EOD tomorrow.
sam: I'll open the schema PR and add migration to curation service. PR will include a small consumer change for the console to show tokenizer_hash.
label-bot: Created ticket CUR-6321: "quant-golden-audit" — assignees: olivia, lee, labeler-2. ETA: 48h.
lee: I'll slot two experienced labelers for relabel queue once we have the sample. Need clear instructions: mark if failure is model quality vs provenance/tokenizer mismatch.
cheng: If it's tokenizer/hash mismatch we can dedupe across variants using fuzzyhash and a threshold (suggest 0.92) and avoid polluting gold.
dan: Also add rollback policy: pin previous model to dedicated canary tests and limit traffic to 10% until gold is stable. If regression >2% we rollback.
maria: Good. Action checklist: 1) sam: add provenance fields + PR link 2) label-bot: create audit queue (done) 3) olivia: sample 5k failing examples, produce 500 immediate audit set 4) lee: relabelers ready 5) eng-sre: hold canary at 10% until cleared. Who owns 3? olivia.
olivia: Copy. Kicking off sampler now. Quick sample command I used:
```bash
python tooling/sample_failures.py --tag quant_mismatch --limit 500 --out s3://curation/quant-audit/3745.csv
```
maria: :thumbsup: sam please ping when PR is up. If the audit shows annotation noise, we'll do a targeted relabel and then re-run eval. If it's tokenizer drift, we'll add tokenizer_hash-based filters.
sam: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/curation/pull/1023 — includes schema + migration + small UI change.
label-bot: Linked PR in ticket CUR-6321 and added checklist items.
lee: One more note — deid pipeline sometimes strips trailing whitespace which shifts token offsets; include that check.
olivia: Will include WS trimming check in audit.
maria: We'll reconvene here after the first audit. If regression persists >2% after relabel, we implement rollback. Otherwise follow staged rollout. Thanks all.
